free_tier.stated: the Basic plan is free and pays only for resources it consumes, with up to 10 concurrent sessions, 100 GiB of included storage and 10 Mbps of basic bandwidth

egress.terms: Free basic bandwidth with a peak of 10 Mbps per instance, measured on inbound traffic, with no SLA; premium bandwidth is billed separately at $0.123/GB inbound. No outbound volume allowance is stated.

interface_detail: Access interface not documented in published terms.

limits.value: 10 concurrent sessions on Basic, 200 on Pro and Ultra

basic bandwidth peaks at 10 Mbps and is measured on inbound traffic; premium bandwidth is billed separately

identity_cost.detail: an Alibaba Cloud international-site account: registration takes an email address and a password, then a mobile number or an email code; 'If you registered your Alibaba Cloud account with an email address, you must complete secure phone number verification', and that number must match the Country/Region chosen at registration. The completed sign-up needs 'Mobile number, payment method, billing address', because the account must 'add payment information before you can buy paid cloud services in regions outside the Chinese mainland or activate the free trial of most paid services'. The Basic plan meters compute, 'you are still charged for any compute resources', so the payment method is the gate; the payment FAQ lists the method as 'such as a credit card or PayPal', and the international site 'does not support binding a mobile number of the Chinese mainland'.

confidence_note: the AgentBay billing page was read on 2026-10-22 and states the plan ladder, the concurrency limit, the storage quota and the bandwidth tier. The free plan carries a pay-as-you-go resource charge, so it is an allowance with a meter rather than a credit
